# Five Points Roofing

> Roofing contractor in Lakeland, Florida, for homes, mobile homes and commercial buildings across Polk County: new roofs, roof replacement, reroofing, repairs and maintenance, storm and hail damage, inspections, and commercial membrane roofs. A family of roofers since 1955: Troy Ray Jr. started Ray's Roofing that year. Florida license CCC1333259, Certified Roofing Contractor, held by Angela M. Ray, doing business as Five Points Roofing; licensed since August 10, 2021, current and active through August 31, 2028 (Florida Department of Business and Professional Regulation). Office at 2587 Colonel Ford Dr., Lakeland, FL 33813, open Monday to Friday, 7 AM to 7 PM. Phone 863-660-5834; email fivepointsroofingfl@gmail.com.

## Roofs

- [Homes](https://www.fivepointsroofingfl.com/#roofs): new roofs, roof replacement, reroofing, repairs and maintenance, storm and hail damage, inspections. Asphalt and dimensional shingles, standing seam metal, flat roofs. Rental roofs kept up to rental standards. Where they look first on a house: pipe flashings, wall and chimney flashing, skylights, valleys.
- [Mobile homes](https://www.fivepointsroofingfl.com/#roofs): repairs, roof overs, membrane roofing, full replacement, coatings. TPO and PVC membranes, aluminum, metal, silicone and rubber coatings. Where they look first: around the pipes, the vents, membrane seams after a storm, ceiling stains inside.
- [Commercial](https://www.fivepointsroofingfl.com/#roofs): inspections, detailed estimates, maintenance and repair programs, full replacement. TPO, PVC, EPDM, modified bitumen, built-up (BUR), coal tar pitch, elastomeric coatings, metal. Where they look first: ponding water, membrane seams, flashing at walls and equipment, drains.

## After a storm

- [Storm damage](https://www.fivepointsroofingfl.com/#storm): call or send a request; they can be on site within five days or less for a free inspection (storm, wind and hail damage), document the damage for the insurance claim with a detailed estimate, and repair the roof up to code.

## Repair, reroof or replace

- [Repair, reroof or replace](https://www.fivepointsroofingfl.com/#replace): repair when the roof is fairly young and the damage stays in one area; reroof (one new layer over a single old layer, on a sound roof) to save time and money; replace when asphalt shingles are past 20 to 25 years, the damage is widespread or repairs keep coming back. A full replacement includes the tear-off down to the deck, deck repairs, new underlayment, new rust-resistant metal flashing and new metal drip edge. On every job: safety barriers, a foreman on site, a dumpster and a magnet sweep for nails. Licensed, bonded and insured.

## Warranties

- [Warranties](https://www.fivepointsroofingfl.com/#warranty): 10-year workmanship warranty on every roof they install; 20-year manufacturer's No Dollar Limit warranty on commercial roofs; 30-year to lifetime material warranty on asphalt shingles. Financing on request with the estimate.
